title: Sunshine and Fresh Air | Designer Inlet Beach Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sunshine and Fresh Air is a Gulf-view home with private beach access, bikes, a nearby community pool, and spacious balconies minutes from Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded: We welcome you to enjoy Sunshine and Fresh Air. This beautiful home offers an open concept living space for your family gatherings while making memories at the beach. The first level is home to 3 bedrooms, a laundry area, 2 full baths, 2 of the bedrooms have access to the rear porch and a path to the community pool steps away. The stairwell opens to the second level offering a large living/dining room with an abundance of natural light from the oversized windows lining the walls. A large balcony runs the entire width of the home where you'll enjoy evening sunsets and the gulf breeze while revisiting the fun events of the day. The second level also boasts a large bedroom with en-suite as a second king suite. You'll find the primary king suite encompassing the entire 3rd level with amazing gulf views. Two-minute bike ride to boutiques and restaurants in beloved Rosemary Beach. Sunshine and Fresh Air features: - Gulf Views on every floor - Access to private Barberry Coast beach access across the street. - Access to 6 backpack chairs and 2 beach umbrellas at the home - 100yds from Winston Lane Public Beach Access. Beach Service available at this location - Deluxe community pool directly behind the home. So close you feel like you have a private pool! - Courtesy use of 5 taxi bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape for your stay - 1st Floor Laundry Room w/ HE Washer + Dryer - 2nd Floor open concept Kitchen/Dining Room w/ professional grade stainless appliances. - Dining table w/ seating for 12 and Breakfast Bar seating for 4 - 2nd Floor Living Room w/ lots of plush seating. The living room also offers a Smart TV and fireplace. - Dining for 8 on a private 2nd floor balcony. Gulf views, including incredible sunset views. - Deluxe patio, with café lights, seating and a firepit - Concierge services available including grocery delivery, eBike rentals, beach chair service, baby equipment rentals, and catered beach bonfires - Whole home WIFI available - Sonos Sound System - Driveway parking for 3 vehicles. Garage access not available. Trailer, RV, and street parking restricted by the HOA. - 2 min bike ride to Rosemary Beach with upscale of shopping and dining options - 7 minutes to the largest Publix in America - 0.5 Miles to 30Avenue. Enjoy live music, award winning restaurants, and incredible shopping. Be sure to visit Amici 30A Italian Kitchen for the best daily Happy Hour on 30A - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor Guest Room | Twin over Twin bunk and a Queen over Queen bunk (sleeps 6), There is also access to a shared hall bathroom with a tub/shower combination
1st Floor Bunk Room | Queen over Queen Bunk (Sleeps 4). There is also a flat-screen TV and access to rear porch. This room also offers access to the hall bath with tub/shower combination.
1st Floor King Suite 1 | Ensuite offering a double vanity, walk-in shower and sleeps 2. There is also a flat screen TV and access to rear porch.
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | Ensuite offering a walk-in shower. There is also a flat screen TV and sleeps 2.

3rd Floor King Suite 3 | Ensuite with double vanity, large soaking tub, and walk-in shower. This room sleeps 2 and has a walk-in closet. There is also a TV and a private porch that has outdoor seating to take in amazing views of the gulf.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night

all: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
